bundle.longDescription: InkUO is a desktop AI assistant for everyday documents. Open a folder, tell it what you need, and it searches your files, drafts new documents, polishes reports, edits Word, Excel, and Markdown files, and can generate new PPT presentations. Designed for non-technical users.
